content:
lol, noting that #38614 was auto-closed by the triage bot for 'LLM-generated' code while Kevin is posting about running out of Claude credits. :p

I get the policy concern, but is there any chance of a human look before the bot has the final word?
PRs are only closed after human review
And also we don’t allow llm + new contributor anymore

Take a look at #use-of-ai; closely reading the policy will answer your question.
AI-generated PRs from new contributors are not allowed (for the reasons explained there). Kevin is a mathlib maintainer, so not a new contributor, and the arguments for that policy no longer apply.
4 messages were moved here from #mathlib4 > #37793 and `to_additive` by Michael Rothgang.
makes sense, still open to any feedback you might have though.
I'm not going to spend time on AI-generated PRs, sorry. People here are generally happy to help you learn, but in the initial stages, you usually learn better without using AI.
There will be an official announcement of the AI policy soon, by the way.

Just to be clear, every line of my LLM-generated PR doing a tedious deprecation chore (which needs to be done ASAP IMO as it has already burnt me in FLT) has been 100% manually reviewed by me, a seasoned contributor to the library, and I am happy to put my name behind it.
@Kevin Buzzard Is there a Zulip thread or GitHub issue tracking the deprecation backlog you mentioned? I’d be happy to help with small ones.
#mathlib4 > #37793 and `to_additive` (but don't worry, the issue is in hand, I'm just at work now)

Michael Rothgang said:

There will be an official announcement of the AI policy soon, by the way.

That announcement is now out: #General announcements > PSA: mathlib AI policy
